verdict: Google profiles are active; paid advertising is off and generating no leads.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all measurable activity came from your three Google Business profiles, which together drove 171 total actions — calls, direction requests, and website clicks. Paid advertising on Meta and Google ran no spend and produced no leads this period, meaning there is no paid pipeline in place. GBP engagement rose 10.64% week over week, which is a real and positive signal, though the last two days of the window showed a dip after a recent peak. Calls from profile impressions remain low across all three locations, and we are focused on improving that conversion rate alongside getting paid channels back into production.

watch_item.issue: Paid advertising on both Meta and Google is inactive, producing zero leads and zero spend this period.
watch_item.fix: Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority so that a paid lead pipeline is in place for the next reporting window.
